Post 1
📉 Banks dragged the ASX 200 down 56pts (-0.64%) to 8,727.90 Wednesday. Financials fell 1.41% — the heaviest sector hit — while the broader index sits virtually flat for the week and year to date. The market is treading water. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🏦 Financials worst sector at -1.41%, Materials down 0.88%. On the other side, A-REITs led gains at +1.00%, Telcos +0.85%, Energy +0.80%. Rate-sensitive property bouncing while banks bleed — a split market sending mixed signals. #ASX #banking #property

Post 3
🔺 Austal surged 10.13% to AUD 4.13 — the session's standout mover. Defence spending tailwinds continue to re-rate the shipbuilder. Meanwhile Paladin Energy cratered 9.34% to AUD 7.28, uranium sentiment turning cold fast. #ASX #ausbiz #defence

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,966.32/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7002. A weaker Aussie dollar is amplifying gold's local price. Silver AUD 84.31/oz, Platinum AUD 2,386.36/oz, Palladium AUD 1,622.32/oz. Metals complex holding firm in local terms. #gold #metals #ASX

Post 5
Watch the AUD/USD 0.70 handle. It is the line between amplified commodity returns for local investors and a currency story that starts dominating headlines. Does it hold or break lower this week? Drop your call below. #ausbiz #ASX #forex #commodities
